title: 市政污水生物處理控制
summary: 「市政污水生物處理控制」教學路線圖：物料與能量平衡、設備整合、監測控制和品質驗證。專案級來源與工序細節待查證。
summaryEn: Learning roadmap for Municipal Wastewater Biological Treatment Control: material and energy balances, equipment integration, monitoring, and quality verification. Project-specific sources and work steps require verification.
